Downloads.Description:
I wanted to redo this recolor since I thought some of the textures looked a little rushed. I also fixed some animation errors I missed! See changelog for more details.

Meant to be used alongside the original furniture mod.

Manifest.Description: A recolor of Hime and Wildflour's Fairy Fountains converted to Alternative Textures!

Downloads.Description:
If you'd rather have the "Texture 1" recolors for Content Patcher, download this file and extract it into:

Mods -> [CP] H&W Fairy Fountains

This will replace the original fountain textures. You CANNOT mix and match colors without the AT version!!
